title: citrus × keraji
intro: Citrus × keraji, commonly known as the Kumquat × Fortunella hybrid, is a plant species that has been identified and studied in recent years. This plant is believed to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Citrus × keraji are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for the development of new natural health products.
